paths.title: Legacy shell helper has no production caller
paths.precondition: Some caller would first need to import and invoke the helper with attacker input.
steps: main.py neither imports nor calls legacy_debug.py; no other fixture file does.
evidence: The subprocess call exists only in the unused helper.
mitigations: Delete the unused shell helper before it acquires a caller.
paths.analysis: The dangerous sink is unreachable from the only production entry point.
paths.validation: Keep an import/call search in review and delete the helper.
